channel.title: Developer Playground - Giri's Place
channel.description: Developer tools and technical blog for software engineers with articles on Kafka, JVM, MongoDB and more.

item.title: Fixing an OOM Only to Create Zombie Batch Pods: The JVM Non-Daemon Thread Trap
item.description: How replacing Spring's default SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor with a bounded ThreadPoolTaskExecutor to fix an OOM caused our CronJob pods to never terminate, creating connection leaks and database exhaustion.

item.title: Funnel Data Collection: Log vs. Kafka — An Engineering Decision Record
item.description: When a data team requests Kafka for funnel event collection, is it really the right tool for the job? An engineering post-mortem on how we decoupled the schema requirement from the transport channel.

item.title: Defense in Depth: Password Salt, Pepper, and Client-Side Hashing Explained
item.description: Salt, Pepper, Client-side Hashing, TLS, and slow KDFs are not rivals. They are complementary layers of defense protecting against different password compromise scenarios.

item.title: Optimizing External API Consumption with Negative Caching
item.description: When 98% of outbound calls fail with 400 Bad Request because users aren't registered on the downstream chat platform, how do you protect your latency? A look into negative caching and cache eviction strategies.

item.title: Preventing OOM in Large Data Rendering Workers: Chunking and PDF Merging
item.description: How loading 4 years of history into memory caused our JVM workers to run out of heap, and how we solved it using paginated chunking and PDF merging.

item.title: The Day an MSK Upgrade Duplicated Every Outbound Record: Why Your Kafka Consumer Needs Idempotency, Not Just Your Producer
item.description: A managed Kafka cluster upgrade rolled brokers, our consumer re-processed already-handled records, and Mongo happily inserted them again because we never set _id. Multiple DLTs, a duplicate-document mess, and the one-line fix that one of our sibling pipelines had been quietly using all along.

item.title: The Hidden Danger of HttpOnly CSRF Cookies in Django
item.description: An incident report on how applying the HttpOnly flag to a CSRF cookie can inadvertently break the Double Submit Cookie pattern and lock users out of your application.

item.title: The EBS PV Availability Zone Trap During EKS Upgrades
item.description: How a legacy gp2 Persistent Volume locked our stateful services to a single AZ, leading to infinite scheduling pending loops during a Kubernetes cluster upgrade.

item.title: The Spring Batch COMPLETED Trap: Why It Doesn't Guarantee Business Success
item.description: Swallowing exceptions in Batch writers creates a silent-failure anti-pattern where a batch is marked COMPLETED even when 100% of rows fail. How to implement proper monitoring and step execution listener controls.

item.title: Spring Redis @Cacheable(sync=true): The Distributed Lock Misconception and the Salvation of JDK 25
item.description: Debunking the myth that sync=true enables distributed locks in Spring Redis, exploring its true local-lock nature in EKS architectures, and unveiling how JDK 25 resolves the infamous Virtual Thread Pinning nightmare.

item.title: Beyond the Kafka Ordering Illusion: Is Switching MQs the Answer?
item.description: Exploring the dilemma between strict ordering and high throughput, the architectural advantages of Apache Pulsar, and why Kafka still dominates the industry landscape despite its limitations.

item.title: Comparing Spring Boot WAS Thread Models & Undertow Optimization in EKS
item.description: A deep dive comparing Tomcat, Jetty, and Undertow thread models, their queueing behaviors, and how to implement dynamic thread allocation and fail-fast strategies to prevent OOMKilled cascading failures in EKS.

item.title: Why 100% Event Ordering in Kafka is an Illusion
item.description: A deep dive into why relying solely on Kafka for perfect event ordering in microservices is an illusion, the underlying causes, and practical design patterns to ensure data consistency.

item.title: The Backfire of MySQL DATETIME Rounding (feat. A Broken 365-Day Streak)
item.description: A deep dive into data integrity issues caused by nanosecond rounding in MySQL\'s DATETIME and TIMESTAMP columns, and how a microsecond can break a user\'s daily check-in streak.

item.title: Claude Skills: Modular Prompt Engineering for Backend Engineers
item.description: Learn how Claude Skills work as reusable prompt modules, how they differ from MCP, and practical use cases for backend development workflows.

item.title: Spring Actuator Port Separation: MVC and WebFlux Have Different Levels of "Isolation"
item.description: Analyzing the difference in isolation levels between MVC (Tomcat) and WebFlux (Netty) when separating Actuator ports in Spring Cloud Gateway, and presenting the correct approach for WebFlux environments.

item.title: Troubleshooting Kafka Consumer: Solving Direct Memory OOM
item.description: A deep dive into diagnosing and resolving java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Direct buffer memory issues in Kafka consumer applications by analyzing internal Kafka client code.

item.title: QR Code Generator - Create QR Codes Instantly
item.description: Generate QR codes instantly from any text, URL, phone number, email, or WiFi credentials. Features real-time generation, download functionality, quick examples, and smartphone scanning instructions. Perfect for sharing links, contact information, or any text data in a scannable format.

item.title: Random Roulette - Decision Making Tool
item.description: Having trouble making decisions? Try our interactive random roulette! Perfect for choosing lunch menus, activities, or any random selection. Features sound effects, customizable options, presets for different categories, and the ability to save/load your configurations.

item.title: Color Palette Generator - Design Tool
item.description: Create beautiful color combinations for your designs! Features various themes like pastel, vibrant, earthy tones and more. Generate harmonious color schemes, copy hex codes with one click, and export palettes as CSS or JSON for easy integration into your projects.

item.title: Effectively Handling RDBMS Transaction Deadlocks in Spring Boot
item.description: 'Learn strategies and implementation methods to prevent, detect, and recover from RDBMS transaction deadlocks in Spring Boot applications.

item.title: Graceful Shutdown of Spring Boot Applications in Kubernetes: SIGTERM, preStopHook, and Actuator
item.description: In modern application development using microservices architecture and container environments, especially Kubernetes, "application termination" means more than just shutting down a process. Abrupt termination can lead to serious problems like data loss, service inconsistencies, and degraded user experience.

item.title: Spring Boot on EKS: Optimizing Health Probes for Efficient Deployments
item.description: When deploying Spring Boot applications on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS), managing application health is crucial for reliable service operations. Kubernetes provides three types of health probes—startup, liveness, and readiness—that work together to ensure your applications start correctly, remain responsive, and handle traffic appropriately.

item.title: Distributed Locks in Spring Boot: Implementation Options and Best Practices
item.description: Distributed locks are synchronization mechanisms used in distributed systems to prevent multiple processes, services, or servers from concurrently executing critical sections of code or accessing shared resources simultaneously.

item.title: RequestContextHolder in Spring Boot: Access and Applications
item.description: RequestContextHolder is a powerful utility class in Spring Framework that provides access to the current HTTP request and response objects through a thread-local storage mechanism.

item.title: Cache Control & ETags with Spring Boot
item.description: Cache Control & ETags: Optimizing Web Performance with Spring Boot.

item.title: CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) & SOP (Same-Origin Policy)
item.description: Explore the concepts of CORS and SOP in web development, including how they work together to prevent CSRF attacks and how to implement CORS.

item.title: Optimizing Kafka Consumer Performance
item.description: Explore effective strategies to optimize Kafka consumer performance including partition-pod 1:1 mapping, concurrent listeners, Confluent Parallel Consumer, and asynchronous processing patterns. Learn implementation techniques, advantages, and trade-offs for each approach to maximize throughput and resource efficiency in your Kafka-based systems.

item.title: Kafka Basics: Topics, Partitions, and Core Concepts
item.description: Learn about Apache Kafka fundamentals including topics, partitions, offsets, producers, consumers, delivery semantics, brokers, Zookeeper, and KRaft concepts.

item.title: MongoDB Sharding Cluster with Docker Compose
item.description: A practical guide to setting up a MongoDB sharding cluster using Docker Compose. Learn about sharding architecture, configuration, and best practices.

item.title: MCP Filesystem Configuration and Usage
item.description: Explore how to configure the Model Connector Provider (MCP) filesystem interface and examine real-world use cases in development environments.

item.title: Effective Identifier Generation in Distributed Systems
item.description: Compare and implement effective strategies for generating unique identifiers in distributed environments, avoiding duplication, and ensuring scalability.

item.title: JVM Warmup: Optimizing Java Application Startup
item.description: Learn about JVM warmup process, how the class loader works through its three stages, and techniques to improve Java application startup performance.

item.title: ZGC: Java's Low-Latency Garbage Collector
item.description: Explore ZGC (Z Garbage Collector), Java's high-performance garbage collector designed for low pause times under 10ms, regardless of heap size from megabytes to terabytes.

item.title: Understanding Java's G1 Garbage Collector
item.description: Deep dive into Java's Garbage-First (G1) garbage collector, how it works, and why it became the default GC in Java 9 for multi-processor machines with large memory.

item.title: How to Prevent Replay Attacks in Web Security
item.description: Understand replay attacks in network security, how they intercept and reuse data packets, and effective prevention methods to protect your applications.

item.title: AWS DocumentDB Comparison Analysis
item.description: Current Issues with AWS DocumentDB (Instance-Based Cluster) - Does not support zero-downtime deployments during bug fixes, increasing code-level management points.

item.title: Understanding R2DBC Connection Pool
item.description: R2DBC connection pooling implements a fundamentally different approach compared to traditional JDBC connection pools like HikariCP, especially in how it handles idle connections and pool initialization.

item.title: Handle Floating Point
item.description: When developing financial applications or systems requiring precise calculations, floating-point precision issues can lead to critical bugs. These problems occur in JVM-based languages like Kotlin, and deciding how to store and process values, especially when interacting with databases, is a crucial design decision.

item.title: IP Address Lookup - Check Your IP Information
item.description: Check your IP address information including IPv4, IPv6, and ISP details. Features real-time IP lookup, location information, and copy functionality for easy sharing.

item.title: HTTP Cookie: The Core Mechanism of Web State Management
item.description: Explore the fundamentals of HTTP Cookies, their security attributes, and how they are used in modern web development.

item.title: Regex Cheatsheet - Language-specific Patterns
item.description: Comprehensive regex patterns for common use cases across different programming languages. Includes email, URL, phone number, IPv4/IPv6, and date format patterns for JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java, Kotlin, Go, and Rust.

item.title: Blockchain: The End of Idealism and Survival as a Tool
item.description: A critical look at how blockchain has shifted from a revolutionary decentralized network to a pragmatic enterprise tool — examining market signals, technical compromises in L2/L3, settlement cost realities, and the rise of RWA tokenization.

item.title: Understanding Kubernetes cgroup v2 & Deep Dive into JVM Pod Memory Issues
item.description: Explore the shift from cgroup v1 to v2 in Kubernetes and dive deep into how this architectural change triggers severe Out-Of-Memory (OOM) issues in JVM-based applications.

item.title: The AWS DocumentDB Maintenance Trap: Why You Cannot Postpone Forever
item.description: AWS DocumentDB maintenance can only be postponed a finite number of times before AWS force-applies it on a date you do not control. Plus the critical distinction between cluster and instance maintenance that nobody explains until you hit it in production.

item.title: Surviving DocDB Failover with Spring Data MongoDB and Kafka: The One-Line Throw That Saved Our Messages
item.description: When a MongoDB primary fails over during peak traffic, the difference between losing every message and retrying every message is exactly one line of Kotlin. The silent-fallback anti-pattern, the fix, and production data from two real DocumentDB maintenances.

item.title: When Your CircuitBreaker Never Opens: Lessons from Two Production DocDB Failovers
item.description: Resilience4j defaults that look reasonable on paper will never fire during a real DocumentDB failover. Plus the MongoDB driver setting that silently blocks every request for 30 seconds. The exact tuning that fixes both.
